request.style: English, male baritone solo with choir, harp, cello, flute, timpani, solemn and ancient, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the family history of Esau
He is Edom in the hill country of Seir
Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan
Adah and Oholibamah and Basemath came
Their possessions were too great to live together
The land could not support their livestock there
So Esau moved away from his brother Jacob
And settled in the land that bears his name

[Chorus]
When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Achbor succeeded him as king
When Baal-Hanan died, Hadar succeeded him as king
His city was named Pau, his wife Mehetabel
Daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-Zahab

[Verse]
Before any king reigned over the Israelites
There were kings who reigned in the land of Edom
Shaul from Rehoboth on the River succeeded Samlah
Then Baal-Hanan took the throne in his place
The list continues in the books of Chronicles
Hadar reigned in his place, his city was named Pai
Mehetabel was his wife, daughter of Matred
The line of Esau grew in the hill country of Seir

[Chorus]
When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Achbor succeeded him as king
When Baal-Hanan died, Hadar succeeded him as king
His city was named Pau, his wife Mehetabel
Daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-Zahab

[Outro]
This is the family history of Esau
That is, Edom, in the land of Seir
